note: Per-sentence variation drills for the Daily Reader (Reza's 2026-10-09 pen note). For each chapter sentence: three rungs. Rung 1 = swap one word for one he already knows. Rung 2 = change the person, number or question form. Rung 3 = combine with another known sentence or add one known word (still ≤ 8 words). Every item is hand-checked for tashkeel and case endings. 'swap' is the one-line hint shown before the reveal. Audio: scripts/gen-audio.py reads this file; scripts/test-chapter-drills.js guards shape + clip coverage.

chap-1.swap: greeting → its reply (the words swap places)

chap-1.en: Peace be upon you and the mercy of Allah.
Peace be upon you, good morning.
Thank you very much for the water.
We want coffee and water, please.
I am hungry, I want food.
How much is the price for that?

chap-1.swap: do you speak → I speak, + a little

chap-1.en: Do you (to a woman) speak Arabic?

chap-2.en: Do you want to eat something?
chap-2.swap: I want → do you want? (both verbs change)

chap-2.en: I want to have breakfast now.
Do you (one person) have a book?

chap-2.swap: do you have? → we have, + here

chap-2.en: I want the bill now, please.
I am thirsty, I want water.
I am thirsty, I want a cup of tea.
I want a cup of tea.
I want two cups of coffee.
I want a cup of coffee with milk.
Here you go, this is your book.
Here you go (to a woman), this is your money.
chap-2.swap: to a man → to a woman

chap-2.en: Here you go, this is the bill.

chap-2.swap: you help me → I help you
I don't want → do you want?

chap-2.en: Thank you, I don't need anything else.
chap-2.ar: شُكْرًا، لَا أَحْتَاجُ إِلَى شَيْءٍ آخَرَ
chap-2.tr: shukran, lā aḥtāju ilā shayʾin ākhar

chap-3.en: I have a reservation at the restaurant.
Do you have a reservation?
We have a reservation at the hotel today.
Where is the car key?
This is the room key.
I need the room key, please.
chap-3.ar: أَحْتَاجُ إِلَى مِفْتَاحِ الغُرْفَةِ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
chap-3.tr: aḥtāju ilā miftāḥi l-ghurfati min faḍlik

chap-3.en: Take me to the mosque, please.
Take us to the station, please.
Take me to the airport quickly, please.
chap-3.ar: خُذْنِي إِلَى المَطَارِ بِسُرْعَةٍ مِنْ فَضْلِكَ
chap-3.tr: khudhnī ilā l-maṭāri bi-surʿatin min faḍlik

chap-3.en: Where is the bus station?
Is the station near?
chap-3.swap: where? → is it near? (station is feminine)

chap-3.en: Where is the train station? Is it far?
chap-3.ar: أَيْنَ مَحَطَّةُ القِطَارِ؟ هَلْ هِيَ بَعِيدَةٌ؟
chap-3.tr: ayna maḥaṭṭatu l-qiṭār? hal hiya baʿīdah?

chap-3.en: This is my luggage in the room.
Is this your luggage?
My luggage is in the car, not here.
How much is the fare to the hotel?
How much is the fare to the airport?
The fare is very expensive.
Stop there, please.
Wait here, please.
Stop here, near the mosque, please.
chap-3.ar: تَوَقَّفْ هُنَا قُرْبَ المَسْجِدِ، لَوْ سَمَحْتَ
chap-3.tr: tawaqqaf hunā qurba l-masjid, law samaḥt

chap-3.en: My key is missing.
My luggage is missing.
This is my passport, here you go.
chap-3.swap: is missing → this is, + here you go

chap-3.en: This is the room door.
Where is the emergency door?
The emergency door is there, near the lift.
Do you need help?
Yes, I need a taxi.
chap-3.swap: do you need? → yes, I need, + a taxi

chap-3.en: No thank you, I don't need anything.
chap-3.ar: لَا شُكْرًا، لَا أَحْتَاجُ إِلَى شَيْءٍ
chap-3.tr: lā shukran, lā aḥtāju ilā shayʾ

chap-4.en: What are you doing now?
What is your friend doing today?
What are you doing today after the lesson?
I will go to the market tomorrow.
We will go to the mosque tomorrow.
I will go to the lesson tomorrow after Fajr.
chap-4.ar: سَأَذْهَبُ إِلَى الدَّرْسِ غَدًا بَعْدَ الفَجْرِ
chap-4.tr: sa-adhhabu ilā d-darsi ghadan baʿda l-fajr

chap-4.en: I read the Quran before sleep.
Did you read the Quran today?
chap-4.swap: I read → DID YOU read? (ـتُ → ـتَ)

chap-4.en: I read the Quran after Fajr at home.
chap-4.ar: قَرَأْتُ القُرْآنَ بَعْدَ الفَجْرِ فِي البَيْتِ
chap-4.tr: qaraʾtu l-qurʾāna baʿda l-fajri fī l-bayt

chap-4.en: When does the work begin?
When does your lesson begin?
When does the lesson begin tomorrow morning?
I have an appointment in the morning.
Do you have an appointment today?
chap-4.swap: I have → DO YOU have? (عِنْدِي → عِنْدَكَ)

chap-4.en: I have an appointment in the evening after Maghrib.
chap-4.ar: عِنْدِي مَوْعِدٌ فِي المَسَاءِ بَعْدَ المَغْرِبِ
chap-4.tr: ʿindī mawʿidun fī l-masāʾi baʿda l-maghrib

chap-4.en: I wrote a letter to my sister.
Did you write the letter?
chap-4.swap: I wrote → DID YOU write? (ـتُ → ـتَ)

chap-4.en: I wrote a letter to my brother after the lesson.
Did you pray Fajr?
I prayed Asr in the mosque. (answer it)
chap-4.swap: you → I — answer the question (ـتَ → ـتُ)

chap-4.en: No, I will pray Asr after the lesson.
chap-4.swap: answer with the FUTURE: سَـ + I pray

chap-4.en: We are learning the Quran.
I am learning Arabic.
We are learning Arabic every day.
I don't know the meaning of this sentence.
Do you know the meaning of this word?
chap-4.swap: I don't know → DO YOU know? (أَعْرِفُ → تَعْرِفُ)

chap-4.en: I don't know this word — what does it mean?
chap-4.ar: لَا أَعْرِفُ هَذِهِ الكَلِمَةَ، مَا مَعْنَاهَا؟
chap-4.tr: lā aʿrifu hādhihi l-kalimah, mā maʿnāhā?
chap-4.swap: + ask back: what does it mean?

chap-4.en: The time now is exactly five o'clock.
What time is it now?
chap-4.swap: turn it into the QUESTION: كَمِ السَّاعَةُ؟

chap-4.en: It is three o'clock now, and the lesson is in an hour.
chap-4.ar: السَّاعَةُ الآنَ الثَّالِثَةُ وَالدَّرْسُ بَعْدَ سَاعَةٍ
chap-4.tr: as-sāʿatu l-āna th-thālithatu wa-d-darsu baʿda sāʿah
chap-4.swap: + and the lesson is in an hour

chap-5.en: My name is Reza, and what is yours?
Where are you from, and where do you live now?
chap-5.ar: مِنْ أَيْنَ أَنْتَ، وَأَيْنَ تَسْكُنُ الآنَ؟
chap-5.tr: min ayna anta, wa-ayna taskunu l-ān?

chap-5.en: I am from Britain and I live in London.
chap-5.ar: أَنَا مِنْ بَرِيطَانِيَا وَأَسْكُنُ فِي لَنْدَن.
chap-5.tr: anā min Brīṭāniyā wa-askunu fī Landan

chap-5.en: I am honoured to meet you.
How are things today after work?
Praise be to Allah, I am fine.
chap-5.swap: fine and well → I am fine

chap-5.en: Praise be to Allah, fine — and you?
Could you help me with the lesson?
chap-5.ar: هَلْ يُمْكِنُ أَنْ تُسَاعِدَنِي فِي الدَّرْسِ؟
chap-5.tr: hal yumkinu an tusāʿidanī fī d-dars?

chap-5.en: I am sorry for being late.
She is sorry for being late.
I am very sorry, the train was late.
You're welcome, no thanks needed, my brother.
chap-5.ar: عَفْوًا، لَا شُكْرَ عَلَى وَاجِبٍ يَا أَخِي.
chap-5.tr: ʿafwan, lā shukra ʿalā wājibin yā akhī

chap-5.en: See you tomorrow, in Allah's safety.
chap-5.ar: إِلَى اللِّقَاءِ غَدًا، فِي أَمَانِ اللَّهِ.
chap-5.tr: ilā l-liqāʾi ghadan, fī amāni llāh

chap-6.en: I live in a big house.
We live in a small flat.
I live in a beautiful flat in London.
chap-6.ar: أَسْكُنُ فِي شَقَّةٍ جَمِيلَةٍ فِي لَنْدَن.
chap-6.tr: askunu fī shaqqatin jamīlatin fī Landan

chap-6.en: In the flat are two bedrooms.
In the house is a kitchen and a bathroom.
In the flat is a bedroom, a kitchen and a small bathroom.
chap-6.ar: فِي الشَّقَّةِ غُرْفَةُ نَوْمٍ وَمَطْبَخٌ وَحَمَّامٌ صَغِيرٌ.
chap-6.tr: fī sh-shaqqati ghurfatu nawmin wa-maṭbakhun wa-ḥammāmun ṣaghīr

chap-6.en: This is the bedroom.
This is the spacious kitchen.
This is the living room, and there is the kitchen.
I have a desk in the bedroom.
She has a big bed.
I have a bed and a wardrobe in the bedroom.
chap-6.ar: عِنْدِي سَرِيرٌ وَخِزَانَةٌ فِي غُرْفَةِ النَّوْمِ.
chap-6.tr: ʿindī sarīrun wa-khizānatun fī ghurfati n-nawm

chap-6.en: In the kitchen is a big fridge.
chap-6.swap: a new oven → a big fridge

chap-6.en: Is there an oven in the kitchen?
In the kitchen is a fridge and an oven, but no washing machine.
chap-6.ar: فِي المَطْبَخِ ثَلَّاجَةٌ وَفُرْنٌ، لَكِنْ لَا غَسَّالَةَ.
chap-6.tr: fī l-maṭbakhi thallājatun wa-furn, lākin lā ghassālah

chap-6.en: On the table are many plates.
Around the table are four chairs.
Around the table are many chairs for the guests.
Where is the door key?
The window curtain is here.
Where is the new window curtain?
The carpet on the floor is beautiful.
Is the carpet clean?
The carpet is clean because I washed it yesterday.
On which floor do you (f) live?
On which floor does your friend live?
On which floor do you live, and is there a lift?
chap-6.ar: فِي أَيِّ طَابِقٍ تَسْكُنُ، وَهَلْ هُنَاكَ مِصْعَدٌ؟
chap-6.tr: fī ayyi ṭābiqin taskun, wa-hal hunāka miṣʿad?

chap-6.en: I live on the first floor.
He lives on the second floor.
I live on the third floor without a lift.
chap-6.ar: أَسْكُنُ فِي الطَّابِقِ الثَّالِثِ بِدُونِ مِصْعَدٍ.
chap-6.tr: askunu fī ṭ-ṭābiqi th-thālithi bidūni miṣʿad

chap-7.en: How much are these shoes?
How much is this bag?
How much is this shirt in pounds?
This is expensive and that is cheap.
This (f) is cheap and that (f) is expensive.
This is cheap, but that one is nicer.
I want one kilo of this.
We want three kilos of dates.
I want three kilos of this, please.
chap-7.ar: أُرِيدُ ثَلَاثَةَ كِيلُو مِنْ هَذَا، مِنْ فَضْلِكَ.
chap-7.tr: urīdu thalāthata kīlū min hādhā, min faḍlik

chap-7.en: Do you accept cash?
Do you (one person) accept cards?
Do you accept cards, or cash only?
chap-7.ar: هَلْ تَقْبَلُونَ البِطَاقَةَ أَمِ النَّقْدَ فَقَطْ؟
chap-7.tr: hal taqbalūna l-biṭāqata ami n-naqda faqaṭ?

chap-7.en: I pay by card, please.
We pay cash today.
I pay cash, I don't have a card.
Do you have a smaller size?
Do you have another colour?
Do you have a bigger size of this shirt?
chap-7.ar: هَلْ عِنْدَكُمْ حَجْمٌ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ هَذَا القَمِيصِ؟
chap-7.tr: hal ʿindakum ḥajmun akbaru min hādhā l-qamīṣ?

chap-7.en: Give me this bag.
Give (f) me this book.
chap-7.swap: to a man → to a woman

chap-7.en: Give me this book and that pen.
Here is the book.
Here (to a woman) is the money.
chap-7.swap: to a man → to a woman

chap-7.en: Here is the money, and keep the change.
This is a very beautiful thing.
This is an excellent idea.
This is an excellent thing, I'll take it.
May Allah bless you in your work.
May Allah bless you (f) in your business.
chap-7.swap: to a man → to a woman

chap-7.en: May Allah bless you in your business and your family.
chap-7.ar: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ فِي تِجَارَتِكَ وَأَهْلِكَ.
chap-7.tr: bāraka llāhu laka fī tijāratika wa-ahlik

chap-8.en: How do I say this in English?
How do we say this word?
How do I say this in Arabic? I forgot.
What is the meaning of this sentence?
What does the word ṭābiq mean?
What is the meaning of this word in English?
I didn't understand, repeat (f) please.
chap-8.swap: to a man → to a woman

chap-8.en: We didn't understand, repeat please.
I didn't understand the last word, repeat it.
Speak (f) slowly, please.
chap-8.swap: to a man → to a woman

chap-8.en: Speak clearly, please.
Speak slowly, I am learning.
I have been learning Arabic for a year.
My mother is learning Arabic too.
I am learning Arabic to understand the Qur'an.
Is my speech correct?
Is his speech clear?
Is my speech clear, or shall I repeat?
Write it for us, please.
Write (f) it for me, please.
chap-8.swap: to a man → to a woman

chap-8.en: Write it for me in Arabic, please.
Wait one minute.
Wait (f) a moment.
chap-8.swap: to a man → to a woman

chap-8.en: Wait a moment, I'm looking for the word.
I forgot the sentence now.
He forgot the word now.
I forgot the word, but I remember the meaning.
I understood you (f) now completely.
We understood you now.
I understood you now, thank you for the patience.

chap-9.en: Where is the prayer place?
Where is the wudu place for women?
Where is the wudu place? I want to pray.
chap-9.ar: أَيْنَ مَكَانُ الوُضُوءِ؟ أُرِيدُ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ.
chap-9.tr: ayna makānu l-wuḍūʾ? urīdu an uṣalliy

chap-9.en: When is the call for Asr prayer?
When is the adhan today?
When is the adhan called, and when is the prayer held?
chap-9.ar: مَتَى يُنَادَى لِلأَذَانِ، وَمَتَى تُقَامُ الصَّلَاةُ؟
chap-9.tr: matā yunādā li-l-adhān, wa-matā tuqāmu ṣ-ṣalāh?

chap-9.en: The mu'adhin called the adhan for prayer.
The imam began the prayer.
The mu'adhin called the iqamah, so we stood for prayer.
Straighten in the rows.
The imam said: straighten and align.
Straighten and align the rows before the takbir.
chap-9.ar: اسْتَوُوا وَاعْتَدِلُوا فِي الصُّفُوفِ قَبْلَ التَّكْبِيرِ.
chap-9.tr: istawū wa-ʿtadilū fī ṣ-ṣufūfi qabla t-takbīr

chap-9.en: I prayed in congregation in the mosque.
They prayed in congregation at home.
We prayed Fajr in congregation in the mosque.
What is the name of the imam of the mosque?
What is the name of the mu'adhin of the Haram?
What is the name of the imam of the Haram this year?
chap-9.ar: مَا اسْمُ إِمَامِ الحَرَمِ هَذَا العَامَ؟
chap-9.tr: mā smu imāmi l-ḥarami hādhā l-ʿām?

chap-9.en: I want a small mushaf.
We want a mushaf for the children.
I want a mushaf to read after the prayer.
May Allah reward you with good.
May Allah reward you (f) with the best reward.
chap-9.swap: to a man → to a woman

chap-9.en: May Allah reward you with good for the lesson.
I pray to Allah for your healing.
We pray to Allah for your (pl) success.
I pray to Allah for your success in the exam.
chap-9.ar: أَدْعُو اللَّهَ لَكَ بِالتَّوْفِيقِ فِي الاِمْتِحَانِ.
chap-9.tr: adʿū llāha laka bi-t-tawfīqi fī l-imtiḥān

chap-9.en: And upon you be peace and Allah's mercy.
Peace be upon you, my brother.
Peace be upon you and Allah's mercy and blessings.

chap-10.en: Today is Monday.
Tomorrow is Saturday.
Today is Friday, and we pray in the mosque.
chap-10.ar: اليَوْمَ يَوْمُ الجُمُعَةِ، وَنُصَلِّي فِي المَسْجِدِ.
chap-10.tr: al-yawma yawmu l-jumuʿah, wa-nuṣallī fī l-masjid

chap-10.en: Yesterday was Sunday.
Yesterday was a long day.
chap-10.swap: which day → what kind of day

chap-10.en: Yesterday was Thursday, and I was at work.
chap-10.ar: أَمْسِ كَانَ يَوْمَ الخَمِيسِ، وَكُنْتُ فِي العَمَلِ.
chap-10.tr: amsi kāna yawma l-khamīs, wa-kuntu fī l-ʿamal

chap-10.en: Tomorrow I have a meeting at the office.
On Sunday I have a lesson with the (female) teacher.
chap-10.ar: يَوْمَ الأَحَدِ عِنْدِي دَرْسٌ مَعَ الأُسْتَاذَةِ.
chap-10.tr: yawma l-aḥadi ʿindī darsun maʿa l-ustādhah

chap-10.en: Tomorrow I have a lesson with the teacher at seven.
chap-10.ar: غَدًا عِنْدِي دَرْسٌ مَعَ الأُسْتَاذِ فِي السَّاعَةِ السَّابِعَةِ.
chap-10.tr: ghadan ʿindī darsun maʿa l-ustādhi fī s-sāʿati s-sābiʿah

chap-10.en: How many minutes do you study a day?
How many hours do you work a week?
I study ten minutes a day, four days.
chap-10.ar: أَدْرُسُ عَشْرَ دَقَائِقَ فِي اليَوْمِ، أَرْبَعَةَ أَيَّامٍ.
chap-10.tr: adrusu ʿashra daqāʾiqa fī l-yawm, arbaʿata ayyām

chap-10.en: I spend the holiday with my friends.
We spend the weekend at home.
I spend the weekend with my family in the park.
chap-10.ar: أَقْضِي نِهَايَةَ الأُسْبُوعِ مَعَ عَائِلَتِي فِي الحَدِيقَةِ.
chap-10.tr: aqḍī nihāyata l-usbūʿi maʿa ʿāʾilatī fī l-ḥadīqah

chap-10.en: In the morning I drink coffee.
In the evening my wife drinks tea.
In the morning I drink tea, then I go to work.
chap-10.ar: فِي الصَّبَاحِ أَشْرَبُ الشَّايَ ثُمَّ أَذْهَبُ إِلَى العَمَلِ.
chap-10.tr: fī ṣ-ṣabāḥi ashrabu sh-shāya thumma adh-habu ilā l-ʿamal

chap-10.en: In the evening I read the Qur'an.
In the evening my son reads a book.
In the evening I read a book before sleeping.
chap-10.ar: فِي المَسَاءِ أَقْرَأُ كِتَابًا قَبْلَ النَّوْمِ.
chap-10.tr: fī l-masāʾi aqraʾu kitāban qabla n-nawm

chap-10.en: When does the train arrive?
When do you (f) arrive home?
When does the plane arrive in London?
I have little time now.
I don't have time now.
I have enough time now for the lesson.
See you the day after tomorrow.
chap-10.swap: next week → the day after tomorrow

chap-10.en: See you on Sunday.
See you next week, God willing.
chap-10.ar: إِلَى اللِّقَاءِ فِي الأُسْبُوعِ القَادِمِ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ.
chap-10.tr: ilā l-liqāʾi fī l-usbūʿi l-qādimi in shāʾa llāh
